notes: Adds optional cloud speech: an advanced setting, off by default, that sends each recording to OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or Groq with your own API key, after a consent step of its own. The speech model on this PC is still used by default and when a request fails. Settings > Clean-up has a box for your own clean-up instructions and a Create the key file button. Settings > Storage offers to move your model files when you change their folder. Help explains what clean-up is, and Settings > About has a new "In plain words" statement, also on the Dictum website.
